name: SUPERChem
intro: SUPERChem是一个具有挑战性的、由专家策划的多模态基准测试，旨在严格评估大型语言模型（LLMs）和多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）的化学推理能力。它包含500个专家策划的推理密集型化学问题，涵盖不同子领域，并以多模态和纯文本格式提供。该基准测试引入了推理路径保真度（RPF）评分，以评估模型推理的质量，超越了最终答案的准确性。
eval_feature: 多模态, 过程评估, 防污染
intro_en: SUPERChem is a challenging, expert-curated multimodal benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate the chemical reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs). It contains 500 expert-curated, reasoning-intensive chemistry questions covering various subfields, presented in both multimodal and pure text formats. The benchmark introduces a Reasoning Path Fidelity (RPF) score to assess the quality of model reasoning beyond final answer accuracy.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with SUPERChem arXiv:2512.01274 Sections 3-4.5; official superchem.pku.edu.cn site and ZehuaZhao/SUPERChem dataset card. SUPERChem curates 500 reasoning-intensive chemistry multiple-choice problems from chemistry competitions, literature adaptation, and expert authorship across diverse subfields. Each item has aligned multimodal and text-only forms plus an expert solution path decomposed into weighted checkpoints. A three-stage domain-expert review process with AI-assisted validation removes flawed or ambiguous items and mitigates contamination. Evaluation runs models on both forms, extracts a final answer for pass@1 accuracy, and sends the question, options, checkpoint-tagged expert path, and candidate reasoning to Gemini 2.5 Pro. The judge marks semantic checkpoint matches, and RPF is the weighted recall of those matches. Results compare accuracy, RPF, modality effects, fine-grained chemistry profiles, and a 40.3% human baseline.
